title: NavigationResponse
description: Schema for an indoor route calculation response in MapLess AI

success.description: True if a valid path was computed

pathNodeIds.description: Ordered sequence of node IDs along the route from start to destination

edgeIds.description: Ordered sequence of edge IDs traversed along the route

totalDistance.description: Total route distance in meters (sum of traversed edge distances)

estimatedTimeSeconds.description: Estimated walking time in seconds (standard walking speed 1.2 m/s)

turnInstructions.description: Step-by-step turn guidance for the user

floorTransitions.description: Multi-floor transition steps via stairs or elevators

message.description: Status message or explanation when no route is found

algorithm.description: Routing algorithm that produced the result (Phase 4)

nodesExplored.description: Number of unique nodes expanded during the search (Phase 4)
